attempts.text:
**The window starts at the anchor `yfaP`.** Column 0 is a spine column, carried by 100% of chromosomes, and it is the stretch most in regions of plasticity: 87% of calls there. The model names `yfaP` in 96% of chromosomes, with 0.09 bits.

**Columns 1 to 6 are variable**, the `ato` genes, [[acetate CoA-transferase and acetyl-CoA C-acetyltransferase]], carried by 77 to 82% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 73 to 87% of calls. The model names 88 to 99% there, fewest at column 1, `atoB`, named 88% with 0.71 bits.

**Then a long spine, columns 7 to 33**, `rcsC` to `narP` through the `nap` and `ccm` genes, [[nitrate reductase and cytochrome c biogenesis]], carried by 92 to 94% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in only 1 to 4% of calls. The model names 96 to 99% of genes, fewest at column 13, `alkB`, named 96%; it hesitates most at column 17, `yojO`, 0.72 bits.

**The fork at column 34, `yejO`**, is the most hesitant column of the window: 0.94 bits, named 88%, in a region of plasticity in 10% of calls; a transposase sits there in 15% of chromosomes. The spine resumes at columns 35 to 46, `yejM` to `yejA`, [[ABC transport and nucleoid-associated proteins]], named 89 to 95%, most hesitant at `yejM`, 0.90 bits. After the variable column 47, `pdeN`, spines run to column 60, `psuT`, [[fructose transport and pseudouridine catabolism]], named 93 to 98%.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns 61 to 79**, `yeiL` to `yeiS`, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 4% of calls. The model names 59 to 97% there, fewest at column 64, named 59%; it hesitates most at column 69, 0.47 bits. Across the window it names 95% of genes at 0.24 bits; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.85 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer, 80% against 97%.

label: yfaP
facts:
WINDOW: the yfaP window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yfaP, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,487 to 1,566 from dnaA. Read in 525 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yfaP once); 42,000 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.24 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 36,926 calls, named 98%, 0.14 bits; shell 4,692 calls, named 83%, 0.76 bits; cloud 382 calls, named 17%, 3.33 bits. Outside an RGP 37,477 calls, named 97%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 4,523 calls, named 80%, 0.85 bits. Columns: 50 spine, 3 fork, 27 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.85 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (80% against 97%); 4,523 of the 42,000 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 34 (yejO) 0.94 bits, RGP 10%; column 35 (yejM) 0.90 bits, RGP 10%; column 17 (yojO) 0.72 bits, RGP 1%. The 7 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 95%, 0.26 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 95%, 0.24 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 0 (spine), RGP 87%; the least: columns 7-33 (spine), RGP 1-4%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 87%. Genes: yfaP "YfaP family protein". named 96%; 0.09 bits.
2. columns 1-6 (6 columns) variable: RGP 73-87%. named 88-99% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1, named 88%, 0.71 bits.
   columns 1-6, share 77-82%, all S: atoB 79%, atoE 82%, atoA "acetate CoA-transferase subunit beta" 82%, atoD 82%, atoC 78%, atoS 77%
3. columns 7-33 (27 columns) spine: share 92-94%, all P, RGP 1-4%. Genes: rcsC, rcsB "response regulator transcription fa…", rcsD, ompC, apbE, ada, alkB, yojI "microcin J25 efflux ABC transporter…", mqo, eco, yojO "protein YojO", napF, napD, napA, napG, napH, napB "nitrate reductase cytochrome c-type…", napC, ccmA, ccmB, ccmC, ccmD, ccmE, ccmF "cytochrome c-type biogenesis heme l…", dsbE, ccmH, narP. named 96-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 13 (alkB), named 96%; most hesitant at column 17 (yojO), 0.72 bits.
4. column 34 fork: RGP 10%. named 88%; 0.94 bits.
   34: yejO S 72% "AIDA repeat-containing protein"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 15%
5. columns 35-46 (12 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 9-10%. Genes: yejM "DUF3413 domain-containing protein", yejL "DUF1414 domain-containing protein", yejK "nucleoid-associated protein", rplY, radD, rsuA, bcr, yejG "YejG family protein", yejF "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", yejE "ABC transporter permease", yejB "microcin C ABC transporter permease…", yejA "extracellular solute-binding protein". named 89-95% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 35 (yejM), named 89%, 0.90 bits.
6. column 47 variable: RGP 9%. named 93%; 0.47 bits.
   47: pdeN P 90%
7. columns 48-53 (6 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 3-8%. Genes: mepS, lpxT, yeiR "CobW family GTP-binding protein", yeiQ "NAD-dependent D-mannonate oxidoredu…", yeiP "elongation factor P-like protein Ye…", yeiW. named 95-98% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 48 (mepS), named 95%, 0.29 bits.
8. column 54 variable: RGP 3%. named 96%; 0.25 bits.
   54: setB P 89%
9. columns 55-57 (3 columns) spine: share 92-93%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: fruB "fused PTS fructose transporter subu…", fruK, fruA. named 93-97% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 57 (fruA), named 93%, 0.24 bits.
10. columns 58-59 (2 columns) variable: RGP 2%. named 91-94% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 58, named 91%, 0.32 bits.
   58: psuK P 88%
   59: psuG P 89% "pseudouridine-5'-phosphate glycosid…"
11. column 60 spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: psuT. named 96%; 0.21 bits.
12. columns 61-79 (19 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 1-4%. named 59-97% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 64, named 59%; most hesitant at column 69, 0.47 bits.
   columns 61-76 variable, share 5-89%, 15 P, 1 S: yeiL "transcriptional regulator YeiL" 87%, rihB 89%, nuoA 5%, yeiI "PfkB family carbohydrate kinase" 88%, nfo 88%, yeiH "putative sulfate exporter family tr…" 88%, yieE "LysR family transcriptional regulat…" 88%, lysP 87%, cirA 80%, yeiG "alpha/beta hydrolase-fold protein" 86%, folE 86%, yeiB "DUF418 domain-containing protein Ye…" 84%, galS 84%, mglB 84%, mglA 83%, mglC "ABC transporter permease subunit" 82%
   77 fork: preA P 81% "4Fe-4S binding protein"; also yohJ P 13%
   78 variable: preT P 81%
   79 fork: yeiS P 78% "DUF2542 family protein"; also sanA P 46%, cdd P 28%, yohK P 17%
